captured_evidence.limitation: The captured UI names settings but does not establish provider protocol, privacy, retry, object naming, or exact original server behavior. This adapter is a reconstruction, not verified provider parity.

provider_docs.use: Authenticated tus video creation and upload

limitations: Opt-in at installation and room level; no external calls are made in tests.
S3 needs RECORDING_EXPORT_S3_REGION and uses a single PUT, limited to 5 GiB; no multipart upload or temporary session credentials.
Vimeo requires an already-authorized access token; client ID and secret alone do not mint an access token.
Vimeo upload hosts are restricted to HTTPS vimeo.com subdomains; other legitimate provider upload domains would need explicit validation before support.
Vimeo upload is one tus PATCH with offset verification; resumable retry, cleanup after partial failure, and idempotent export state are not implemented.
Vimeo private-view setting and numeric folder IDs depend on provider account permissions; unverified against live provider.
A failed or unavailable export never deletes or changes the ready local recording.
